draft_key_information_units.information: 2025 delivered record financial performance with revenue increasing 40% to DKK 126.5m, EBITDA growing 26% to DKK 31.1m, and EBT surging 109% to DKK 19.0m.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Highlights & Key Ratios table on page 24 shows revenue of DKK 126,523k (2024: 90,070k), EBITDA of DKK 31,117k (2024: 24,671k), and EBT of DKK 19,013k (2024: 9,068k). Confirmed in Financial Performance section pages 24-25.

draft_key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 was the strongest quarter in company history with revenue of DKK 40.96m, a 106% year-over-year increase, driven primarily by Farm Manager, Truck Manager, and Airline Manager.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Q4 Financial Performance section pages 27-28: Q4 2025 revenue DKK 40,959k vs Q4 2024 DKK 19,924k (+106%). Breakdown: Farm Manager DKK 11,692k, Truck Manager DKK 8,992k, Airline Manager DKK 10,248k.

draft_key_information_units.information: In-app advertising revenue surged 100% to DKK 18.5m (14.6% of total revenue) following strategic optimisation initiatives initiated in late September 2025, with full deployment expected by end of Q2 2026 to increase IAA to 18.2% of revenue.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Strategic Ad Revenue Optimisation section pages 21-22: IAA revenue DKK 18,476k in 2025 vs DKK 9,226k in 2024 (+100%); stated as 14.6% of 2025 revenue, with guidance for 2026 IAA to reach 18.2% of total revenue.

draft_key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' game series (Airline Manager, Truck Manager, Farm Manager) drove 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, with Truck Manager growing from DKK 1.2m in 2024 to DKK 25.2m in 2025 and Farm Manager generating DKK 22.0m in its first six months.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results pages 13-14: 'Big 3' generated 67% of revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA. Truck Manager revenue DKK 25,181k (2024: DKK 1,216k). Farm Manager revenue DKK 22,002k (launched July 2025). Game Breakdown table page 13 confirms series contributions.

draft_key_information_units.information: 2026 financial guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3-21% YoY), EBITDA of DKK 28-36m, and EBT of DKK 18-24m, with focus on optimising the current portfolio and disciplined investment in next-generation titles like Train Manager 2 and Space Manager.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 section pages 10-11: Revenue guidance DKK 130-153m, EBITDA DKK 28-36m, EBT DKK 18-24m. Operational priorities include portfolio optimisation and next-gen titles Train Manager 2 and Space Manager.

draft_key_information_units.information: To navigate weakening USD in H1 2025, the company strategically increased user acquisition budgets during the period, sacrificing short-term profitability for long-term market share and lifetime value, leveraging reduced real-cost marketing spend.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Letter from the CEO pages 4-5: 'The reduced real-cost of marketing spend in key territories allowed us to increase our user acquisition budgets substantially during the period... This disciplined capital allocation choice demonstrates our data-driven 'no-bullshit' mentality in action: sacrificing short-term profitability for greater long-term market share and lifetime value.'

draft_key_information_units.information: The company maintained a strong capital position with a 78% solvency ratio, completed a DKK 5m share buy-back program (repurchasing 458,572 shares at an average price of DKK 10.89), and held DKK 23.0m cash at year-end, supporting organic growth and potential acquisitions.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Review page 26: Solvency ratio 78% (2024: 86%), cash at bank and in hand DKK 23,049k. Shareholder Information page 42: Share buy-back program total DKK 4,894k, average price DKK 10.89, 458,572 shares repurchased. Treasury shares 1,068,502 (3.87%).

draft_key_information_units.information: The Board highlighted emerging regulatory risks from the EU Digital Fairness Act (DFA) and emphasised ESG commitments including 100% renewable energy for servers, operational efficiency, and social initiatives supporting player well-being and employee flexibility.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Letter from the Chair of the Board page 5-6: Board assessed durability against EU DFA. Environmental section pages 30-32: Server host powered by 100% Danish solar energy. Social section pages 32-33: People-first culture, player well-being focus, and flexible working arrangements.

evaluation.selection_rationale: The draft units cover material summary-level content directly supporting concise financial-report summaries. Prioritisation follows the specified criteria: headline financial performance (D1), major period-over-period changes (D2, D3, D4), performance drivers (D3, D4, D6), segment developments (D4), liquidity/capital (D7), operational strategy (D5, D6), and material post-reporting events (D5). D8 addresses regulatory and ESG factors highlighted by the Board, though less central to core financial performance. All units are independently omittable themes supported exclusively by the SOURCE FINANCIAL REPORT, with no external knowledge or invented causal relationships. The list contains 8 units, within the 6–10 target range.
